reply_text:
I've answered Tobias in his thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the site was Southgate.

The answer comes from the incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she posted that labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared its backlog.

I couldn't give him a street address. The channel doesn't mention one, and the file share has no Tansley account files.

The gbrain search was refused because this connection isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. To fix that, someone on the brain host needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<MEMBER>'`.
